description: PHP source file for OpenX Schema Management Utility within Revive Adserver, handling schema editing, cookies, and schema operations.

classes.name: openXSchemaEditor
classes.description: Class responsible for schema editing operations such as creating, deleting, saving, and parsing schema files.

methods.name: createTransitional
methods.description: Creates a transitional schema.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Creates a new schema with a specified name.

methods.name: deleteTransitional
methods.description: Deletes the transitional schema.

methods.name: createChangeset
methods.description: Creates a changeset for schema modifications.

methods.name: deleteChangesTrans
methods.description: Deletes the transitional changeset.

methods.name: commitFinal
methods.description: Commits the final schema changes with comments and version.

methods.name: setWorkingFiles
methods.description: Sets the working files for schema editing.

methods.name: fieldSave
methods.description: Saves changes to a field in a table.

methods.name: fieldAdd
methods.description: Adds a new field to a table.

methods.name: fieldDelete
methods.description: Deletes a field from a table.

methods.name: indexDelete
methods.description: Deletes an index from a table.

methods.name: indexAdd
methods.description: Adds an index to a table.

methods.name: indexSave
methods.description: Saves an index configuration.

methods.name: linkDelete
methods.description: Deletes a foreign key link.

methods.name: linkAdd
methods.description: Adds a foreign key link.

methods.name: tableSave
methods.description: Saves changes to a table.

methods.name: tableDelete
methods.description: Deletes a table.

methods.name: tableNew
methods.description: Creates a new table.

methods.name: parseWorkingDefinitionFile
methods.description: Parses the current working schema definition file.

methods.name: readForeignKeys
methods.description: Reads foreign key constraints for a table.

methods.name: getLinkTargets
methods.description: Retrieves possible link target tables.
